title: The Dashboard That Mixes Sensor Readings
description: A sensor dashboard includes stale/future readings and leaks one device's samples into another device's average.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: window_average(rows,device,now,window) returns the arithmetic mean for that device at timestamps in (now-window,now], or None/nullopt if no matching readings. Require positive window. Input readings have device, time, value; zero and negative values are valid. C++ Reading has string device and double time/value. Never mutate rows.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
